metadata.title: Orchestrator Playground
metadata.description: Configure the orchestrator's agents, teams and tools and test them in chat.

common.schemaLoadError: Could not load the orchestrator options
common.schemaReadOnly: Configuration is read-only: the orchestrator does not accept changes.
common.loadErrorHint: The orchestrator didn't respond. Check that it's running and try again.
common.filterEmptyHint: Check the spelling or clear the filters.
common.conflictIntro: A newer version was saved while you were editing.
common.conflictDescription: A newer version (v{current}) was saved while you were editing v{mine}. {count, plural, one {# form field differs} other {# form fields differ}} from the current version.
common.conflictNoVisible: A newer version (v{current}) was saved while you were editing v{mine}, but no form field differs. The change is in something this form doesn't show.
common.conflictNoVisibleHelp: Overwriting saves only what the form covers; the rest of the current version stays as it is.
common.conflictLoading: Fetching the current version to compare…
common.conflictLoadError: Couldn't fetch the current version (code {status}). Without it you can't compare or overwrite.
common.conflictLoadErrorNoCode: Couldn't fetch the current version. Without it you can't compare or overwrite.
common.conflictConsequence: Reloading discards your edits. Overwriting replaces the current version's values with yours.
common.conflictAgain: It changed again while you were deciding. The comparison was refreshed and nothing was saved.
common.conflictSame: Differences only; {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} the same in both.
common.changedDescription: A newer version was saved before this action. {action, select, delete {Nothing was deleted.} deactivate {Nothing was deactivated.} other {Nothing was reactivated.}} Reload to see the current version and decide again.
common.changedDirty: Reloading discards the form's unsaved edits.
common.dirtyNote: You have unsaved edits. They stay in the form; this action doesn't save them.

secretRef.helpEnv: Environment variable on the orchestrator server, UPPERCASE and ending in {suffix}.
secretRef.helpFile: Absolute path of a file on the orchestrator server that holds the key.
secretRef.errorEnv: Use UPPERCASE letters, digits and _, starting with a letter and ending in {suffix} (e.g. {example}), up to 128 characters.
secretRef.errorFile: Use an absolute path starting with / (e.g. {example}).
secretRef.warnOutOfRule: The saved reference is outside the orchestrator's rule. It decides on save; fix it if you won't keep it.
secretRef.warnNoFormat: The saved reference uses no accepted format ({formats}). The orchestrator decides on save; pick a format to fix it.
secretRef.warnUnknownFormat: The {format} format isn't among the accepted ones ({formats}). The orchestrator decides on save; pick a format to fix it.
secretRef.unavailable: Formats come from the orchestrator. Use “Try again” in the notice above.

agents.title: Agent management
agents.subtitle: Create and manage your AI agents
agents.emptyTitle: The orchestrator has no agents yet
agents.emptyDescription: An agent combines a model, instructions and tools. Create the first one and chat with it in the playground.
agents.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the agent "{name}"? This action can't be undone.
agents.deleteBlockedDescription: {name} is a member of {count, plural, one {# team. Remove it from its member list} other {# teams. Remove it from each member list}} and try again.
agents.deleteBlockedGeneric: The orchestrator refused: the agent is a member of one or more teams.
agents.conflict: An agent with this ID already exists
agents.conflictDeletedDescription: “{name}” was deleted while you were editing. Your edits can't be saved here; copy what you need before leaving.
agents.deactivateDescription: The orchestrator stops loading the agent “{name}”, but its configuration stays saved. You can reactivate it here whenever you want.

form.basicInfoDescription: How the agent shows up in the list and in the chat.
form.name: Name *
form.modelSettingsDescription: Provider, model and how the orchestrator connects to it.
form.baseUrlHelp: http(s)://host[:port][/path], no user, password, query or fragment.
form.baseUrlNotUsed: {vendor} doesn't use a base URL. The orchestrator decides on save; clear it to remove it.
form.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a helpful assistant that…
form.ragDescription: Knowledge base the agent queries: document, search and the model that creates the embeddings.
form.toolsDescription: Select the tools the agent can use
form.noTools: No tools available. Create tools first.
form.instructionsDescription: The system prompt that guides the agent in every conversation.
form.modelParamsHelp: Names {vendor} accepts. Value: number with a dot (0.7), true/false or text.
form.modelParamsAllUsed: All of {vendor}'s parameters are already listed.
form.modelParamsEmpty: No parameters: the model uses the provider defaults.
form.modelParamNotAccepted: {vendor} doesn't accept {name}. The orchestrator decides on save; remove it if unused.
form.executionDescription: What context the agent gets and how it replies.
form.markdownHelp: Headings, lists and code formatted in the chat.
form.addDatetimeHelp: The agent knows the current date and time.
form.addHistoryHelp: The latest runs of the session go along with each question.
form.numHistoryRunsOff: Turn on history to use it.
form.numHistoryRunsRange: Use a whole number from {min} to {max}
form.reasoningHelp: The model thinks in steps before replying.
form.reasoningWarning: More model calls per reply, and tools can be called during this phase. Avoid it with tools that change data (POST, PUT, DELETE).
form.userMemoryHelp: Keeps facts about the user across sessions.
form.summaryHelp: Summarizes the conversation to keep context in long sessions.
form.executionUnavailable: Execution options come from the orchestrator. Use “Try again” in the notice above.
form.ragEnableHelp: Turn it off to pause RAG without losing the setup.
form.ragEmbedderHelp: Model that turns text into vectors for the search.
form.ragEmptyKey: Empty: the embedder sets no key of its own.
form.ragParamsEmpty: No parameters: the embedder uses the provider defaults.
form.ragOffKept: RAG is off. The values stay saved and come back when you turn it on: {summary}.
form.ragOffEmpty: RAG is off: the agent answers without a knowledge base.
form.ragDiscarded: RAG values discarded. Saving removes the configuration.
form.ragReopened: RAG is off, with fields shown because one has an error. The values stay saved.
form.ragUnavailable: RAG options come from the orchestrator. Use “Try again” in the notice above.
form.apiKeyRefEmpty: Empty: the agent sets no key of its own.

teams.title: Teams management
teams.subtitle: Create and manage teams of agents, each with a leader
teams.emptyTitle: The orchestrator has no teams yet
teams.emptyDescription: A team puts agents under a leader that decides who answers. Create the first one and test it in the playground.
teams.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the team “{name}”? This can't be undone. Member agents aren't deleted.
teams.conflict: A team with this ID already exists
teams.conflictDeletedDescription: “{name}” was deleted while you were editing. Your edits can't be saved here; copy what you need before leaving.
teams.deactivateDescription: The orchestrator stops loading the team “{name}”, but its configuration stays saved. You can reactivate it here whenever you want.

form.newSubtitle: Set up a new team of agents
form.basicInfoDescription: How the team shows up in the list and in the chat.
form.name: Name *
form.membersDescription: The agents the leader can call on to answer.
form.membersHelp: Check the agents the team can call on. At least one. Inactive agents can be checked; the orchestrator decides on save.
form.membersSearchAria: Search agent by name, id or description
form.membersEmptyHint: A team needs at least one member. Create an agent and come back to build the team.
form.membersSaveBlocked: Save stays disabled until the list loads, so members aren't saved blindly.
form.memberMissing: This agent no longer exists. Uncheck it to remove it; otherwise the orchestrator rejects the save.
form.membersNotLoaded: Outside the loaded list (showing {shown} of {total} agents).
form.modeDescription: How the leader splits the work among the members.

modeDescriptions.route: Picks one member and hands over the question. The reply is that member's.
modeDescriptions.coordinate: Delegates parts to members and merges the answers into one.
modeDescriptions.broadcast: Sends the same question to every member and synthesizes the answers.
modeDescriptions.tasks: Splits the request into tasks, assigns them to members and repeats until done.

form.modeNotInSchema: {mode} isn't among the orchestrator's modes. The orchestrator decides on save; choosing another mode removes this one.
form.modeUnavailable: Mode options come from the orchestrator. Use “Try again” in the notice above.
form.modelSettingsDescription: Provider, model and how the orchestrator connects to it. The leader chooses, delegates and answers for the team.
form.instructionsDescription: The prompt that guides the leader when coordinating the members.
form.systemPromptPlaceholder: You coordinate the team members and…
form.executionDescription: What context the team gets and how it replies.
form.apiKeyRefEmpty: Empty: the team sets no key of its own.

tools.title: Tool management
tools.subtitle: Create and manage HTTP tools for your agents
tools.emptyTitle: The orchestrator has no tools yet
tools.emptyDescription: A tool is an HTTP call an agent can make. Create the first one and attach it to an agent.
tools.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the tool "{name}"? This action can't be undone.
tools.conflict: A tool with this ID already exists
tools.conflictDeletedDescription: “{name}” was deleted while you were editing. Your edits can't be saved here; copy what you need before leaving.
tools.deactivateDescription: The orchestrator stops loading the tool “{name}”, but its configuration stays saved. You can reactivate it here whenever you want.

form.name: Name *
form.instructionsPlaceholder: Specific instructions for using the tool…
form.parametersDescription: Configure the parameters the API accepts
form.routeHelp: Use '{'name'}' for a path parameter, e.g. /v1/orders/'{'order_id'}'. The host doesn't accept placeholders.
form.routeMissingParams: The route uses {names} without a required parameter of the same name.
form.paramRequiredLocked: Required because the name is in the route
form.defaultNote: The orchestrator doesn't send the default value on its own: it's only an example in the preview.

defaultInvalid.float: Use a number with a dot (e.g. 0.5)

form.headersHelp: Text or Secret ({prefixes} reference). A sensitive name (Authorization, Cookie, …-Key, …-Token) accepts Secret only. Switching mode clears the value.
form.headersMaskedNote: *** is the stored, hidden value. It stays until you replace it, and only if the route origin ({origin}) doesn't change.
form.headersOriginChanged: The route origin changed ({from} → {to}). The orchestrator only keeps hidden values on the same origin: replace {names}.
form.headerSensitive: {name} is sensitive: use Secret (reference {prefixes}), never the value.
form.headerDuplicate: A header with this name already exists
form.headersRejected: The orchestrator rejected a header without saying which. Check sensitive names (use a reference) and the route origin.
form.requestDescription: How the orchestrator builds the call. Nothing is sent.
form.requestEmpty: Enter the route to see the request.
form.requestLegend: Text is hidden; references and *** are shown as they are.
form.requestLegendPlaceholder: no default: the model fills it in
form.routePlaceholderSpaces: The name between braces can’t start or end with a space: fix {names}.
